hero.title: HealTheCrop
hero.subtitle: Grow smarter, not harder.
hero.description: HealTheCrop helps farmers make data-driven decisions using real-time soil monitoring, machine learning, and intelligent crop recommendations — built for real fields, in the language you speak.

about.title: What is HealTheCrop?
about.subtitle: A farming companion that turns raw soil data into decisions you can act on.
about.point1Text: Designed around actual ESP32 field sensors, not just a lab demo — it works with the soil you actually have.
about.point2Text: Matching the right crop to your soil and season reduces guesswork and improves harvest outcomes.
about.point3Text: AI-backed recommendations replace intuition-only decisions that often lead to poor yields.
about.point4Text: Fertility tracking and targeted improvement suggestions help restore soil health season after season.
about.point5Text: A visual, multilingual interface designed for farmers of every literacy level.
about.point6Text: Every reading and scan builds a history you can learn from over time.

howItWorks.title: From soil to recommendation, automatically
howItWorks.subtitle: A simple, transparent pipeline connects your field to your dashboard.
howItWorks.step1Text: FC-28 moisture, DHT11 temperature/humidity, and pH probes read your soil's condition.
howItWorks.step2Text: A Wi-Fi microcontroller collects readings and securely sends them to the cloud.
howItWorks.step3Text: Readings and images are stored safely, first locally, then synced to the backend.
howItWorks.step4Text: The FastAPI backend validates, organizes, and prepares your data for analysis.
howItWorks.step5Text: A trained machine learning model analyzes nutrients, climate, and season together.
howItWorks.step6Text: You receive a ranked list of suitable crops with confidence scores.
howItWorks.step7Text: Everything comes together in one visual, easy-to-read dashboard.

features.title: Everything a modern farm needs, in one place
features.soilMonitoringText: Live moisture, temperature, humidity, and pH from your connected sensors.
features.aiRecommendationText: Random Forest predictions with confidence scores and top-5 alternatives.
features.fertilityAnalysisText: A clear 0-100 fertility score with color-coded nutrient indicators.
features.fertilityImprovementText: Organic and chemical fixes explained with why, how, and expected results.
features.pestDetectionText: Photograph a leaf and get treatment options in seconds.
features.analyticsText: Trend charts and prediction history so you can track progress over time.
features.multilingualText: Full interface in English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, and Malayalam.
features.manualModeText: Get recommendations instantly, even without any hardware connected.
features.storageText: MinIO-backed storage for images and reports, with automatic local fallback.
features.smartDashboardText: One screen for devices, readings, predictions, and system health.

whyUse.title: Real benefits, from planting to harvest

ai.title: Powered by a trained Random Forest model
ai.description: HealTheCrop's recommendation engine is a Random Forest classifier trained on agricultural data. It weighs nine factors together to recommend crops suited to your exact conditions.

footer.projectText: A final-year engineering project combining IoT, machine learning, and computer vision for smart agriculture.
